'''Nemats''' were flying [[Insectoid/Legends|insectoid]] [[Diet/Legends|sanguivores]] from the swamps of [[Ergeshui/Legends|Ergeshui]]. They stunned victims with sonic attacks. Nemats preyed in swarms on [[Garalalesh]] or any warm-[[Blood/Legends|blooded]] creature.
